**Chiral Low-Energy Constants ∗ Gerhard Ecker Faculty of Physics, Univ. of Vienna**

*Boltzmanngasse 5, A-1090 Vienna, Austria*

12 pp, 6 sections.

**Abstract.** The progress in determining the coupling constants of meson ic chi- ral Lagrangians is reviewed, with emphasis on the work perfo rmed in three successive European Networks (Eurodaphne I and II, Eu ridice). Reliable estimates of those constants are essential for mak ing full use of next-to-next-to-leading-order calculations in chiral pe rturbation the- ory. The precision in the values of the strong coupling const ants of O(p4) has been increasing steadily over the years. The situation is less satisfactory in the nonleptonic weak sector where furt her phe- nomenological input and more theoretical work are needed. A lot of progress has recently been achieved for electromagnetic co upling con- stants occurring in radiative corrections for mesonic proc esses at low energies. ∗Presented at The Final Euridice Meeting, Kazimierz, Poland, Aug. 20 06 Supported in part by EU contract No.

**Outline.** Introduction; Strong interactions; Nonleptonic weak interactions; Dynamical photons; Dynamical photons and leptons; Outlook
